title: End VA abortion services and gender reassignment surgery
proposal: The VA should rescind clinical policies that conflict with conservative principles, starting with abortion services and gender reassignment surgery.
quote: Rescind all departmental clinical policy directives that are contrary to principles of conservative governance starting with abortion services and gender reassignment surgery.

title: Write VA community care access standards into law
proposal: If Congress is favorable, the administration should quickly put the VA MISSION Act's standards for getting care from private doctors into law so the VA cannot weaken them.
quote: the next Administration should rapidly and explicitly codify VA MISSION Act access standards in legislation to prevent the VA from avoiding or watering down the requirements

title: Create a veterans bill of rights
proposal: A veterans bill of rights should spell out what benefits veterans are entitled to, set a process for disputes, and make sure veterans are told about Community Care eligibility.
quote: First and foremost, a veterans bill of rights is needed so that veterans and VA staff know exactly what benefits veterans are entitled to receive,

title: Issue new directives to strengthen VA community care
proposal: The administration should issue new Secretary-level directives to carry out the VA MISSION Act, including eligibility, access and quality standards, and veteran education on care options.
quote: the next Administration should create new Secretarial directives to implement the VA MISSION Act properly.

title: Move VA's Office for Innovation of Care and Payment
proposal: The Office for Innovation of Care and Payment should return to the Office of Enterprise Integration, with joint governance with the VHA.
quote: returning the Office for Innovation of Care and Payment to the Office of Enterprise Integration with a joint governance process set up with the VHA

title: Overhaul the VA Family Caregiver Program expansion
proposal: The Family Caregiver Program expansion should be overhauled to focus on consistent eligibility and on the long-term needs of the most severely injured.
quote: overhauling Family Caregiver Program expansion, which has gone poorly, so that it focuses on consistency of eligibility

title: Require public reporting on VA health care performance
proposal: The VHA should publicly report on quality, safety, patient experience, timeliness, and cost, using standards like Medicare's Accountable Care Organization program.
quote: Require the VHA to report publicly on all aspects of its operation, including quality, safety, patient experience, timeliness, and cost-effectiveness,

title: Have VA medical centers seek local academic and private input
proposal: VA Medical Centers should seek input from local academic and private-sector experts to improve patient experience.
quote: Encourage VA Medical Centers to seek out relevant academic and private-sector input in their communities to improve the overall patient experience.

title: Conduct an independent audit of the VA
proposal: The VA should get an independent audit, like the 2018 Defense Department audit, to find IT, management, financial, and contracting problems.
quote: Conduct an independent audit of the VA similar to the 2018 Department of Defense (DOD) audit to identify IT, management, financial, contracting, and other deficiencies.

title: Shift VA care from old hospitals to outpatient clinics
proposal: The VA should expand Community Based Outpatient Clinics in hard medical markets instead of investing more in outdated hospital campuses.
quote: Embrace the expansion of Community Based Outpatient Clinics (CBOCs) as an avenue to maintain a VA footprint in challenging medical markets

title: Pilot facility sharing between VA and local health systems
proposal: The VA should explore pilot partnerships to share facilities with strained local health systems to cut costs.
quote: Explore the potential to pilot facility-sharing partnerships between the VA and strained local health care systems to reduce costs

title: Give the VA Under Secretary for Health a five-year term
proposal: The Under Secretary for Health should serve a five-year term that can be renewed once, for continuity across administrations.
quote: Extend the term of the Under Secretary for Health (USH) to five years.

title: Create a chief information officer for the VA health system
proposal: The VA should create a senior executive Chief Information Officer position for the VHA Care System.
quote: Establish a Senior Executive Service (SES) position of VHA Care System Chief Information Officer (CIO),

title: Require VA providers to see about 19 patients per day
proposal: VHA facilities should raise daily patient loads to match Defense Department facilities, about 19 patients per provider per day, to cut wait times.
quote: Require VHA facilities to increase the number of patients seen each day to equal the number seen by DOD medical facilities: approximately 19 patients per provider per day.

title: Pilot evening and Saturday VA appointments
proposal: The VA should consider a pilot of longer weekday hours and Saturday appointments at facilities with delays.
quote: Consider a pilot program to extend weekday appointment hours and offer Saturday appointment options to veterans

title: Allow higher pay for hard-to-fill VA clinical jobs
proposal: The VA should identify high-demand clinical services that are costly to staff and examine exceptions allowing higher competitive pay.
quote: Identify clinical services that are consistently in high demand but require cost-prohibitive compensation to recruit and retain talent, and examine exceptions for higher competitive pay.

title: Review VA facilities with low community care referrals
proposal: The VA should look at facilities where Community Care referrals are unusually low or often expire or are canceled, and find ways to improve.
quote: Assess the medical facilities where Community Care is readily available but referrals for Community Care are below the averages in other similar markets,

title: Expand VA telehealth
proposal: The VA should explore more telehealth to cut personnel costs and serve veterans, and keep expanding rural broadband.
quote: Further explore how to leverage telehealth to reduce personnel costs across the enterprise and serve veterans.

title: Recruit retired physicians to the VA
proposal: The VA should consider strongly recruiting retired doctors who want to serve veterans.
quote: Consider aggressively recruiting retired physicians who desire to serve veterans.

title: Offer VA tuition aid for service in understaffed areas
proposal: The VA should consider expanding tuition assistance in exchange for service at rural or understaffed VA medical centers.
quote: Consider expanding VA tuition assistance in exchange for reciprocal service in rural or understaffed VAMCs.

title: Assess VA electronic health record rollout problems
proposal: The VA should make a top-priority assessment of delays and problems with its new electronic health record system.
quote: Conduct a high-priority assessment of Electronic Health Record (EHR) transition delays and functionality problems.

title: Set and publish VA benefits performance targets
proposal: The Veterans Benefits Administration should set performance targets and publicly report results every quarter.
quote: Identify performance targets for benefits, report publicly on actual performance each quarter, and use these metrics to drive consistent improvement.

title: Pilot 30-day processing of first disability claims
proposal: The VBA should pilot an "Express 30" goal to finish a veteran's first fully developed disability claim in 30 days.
quote: Develop a new pilot “Express 30” commitment for a veteran’s first fully developed disability compensation claim

title: Use more private companies for disability exams
proposal: The VA should hire more private companies to do disability medical exams to reduce delays.
quote: Hire more private companies to perform disability medical examinations. Delays in completing the examinations could be eliminated with more external capacity.

title: Automate VA disability claims processing
proposal: The VBA should use technology to do most claims work instead of relying on hiring more staff.
quote: The best way to provide benefits faster and more accurately is by using technology to perform most of the work.

title: Reduce improper VA benefit payments
proposal: The VA should use better tools, training, management, and rule changes to reduce about $500 million in improper payments each year.
quote: Reduce improper payment and fraud. About $500 million is improperly paid out each year.

title: Revise disability ratings for future claimants
proposal: The administration should explore speeding up reviews of the VA disability rating schedule to save money by revising ratings for future claimants while protecting current ones fully or partly.
quote: explore how VASRD reviews could be accelerated with clearance from OMB to target significant cost savings from revising disability rating awards for future claimants

title: Reassess VBA technology budget
proposal: The VBA's IT budget should be reexamined given the need for more automation, and the VBA should make the case for a larger share.
quote: The VBA’s Information Technology top-line budget should be reexamined and reassessed in light of the need for expanded automation

title: Use more contractors to process VA claims
proposal: The VBA should build a workforce with more contractors processing claims, with federal employees making final benefit decisions.
quote: build a more blended workforce with more contractors to process claims.

title: Expand VBA outreach to top contractors
proposal: The VBA should improve its acquisition workforce and do more outreach to bring in top private contractors.
quote: Improve the VBA acquisition workforce. The VBA needs more world-class contractor support.

title: Create a VBA knowledge exchange with private companies
proposal: The VBA should set up a knowledge exchange with top private companies that do similar claims work.
quote: establish a knowledge exchange program with top-tier private-sector companies that do similar work.

title: Rescind all prior VA delegations of authority
proposal: The VA should rescind all delegations of authority issued under the previous administration.
quote: Rescind all delegations of authority promulgated by the VA under the prior Administration.

title: Remove career executives from VA political posts on Day One
proposal: On the first day, career senior executives should be moved out of positions designated for political appointees to ensure political control of the VA.
quote: Transfer all career SES out of PA/PAS-designated positions on the first day and ensure political control of the VA.

title: Review remote and hybrid work at VA headquarters
proposal: The VA should closely review where remote and hybrid work helps and where in-person work is needed at headquarters.
quote: Take a close and analytically critical look at where hybrid and remote work is a net positive as a functional necessity

title: Buy a new VA human resources IT system
proposal: The VA should speed up buying a new human resources information technology system.
quote: Expedite the acquisition of a new Human Resources Information Technology (HRIT) system.

title: Raise VA pay for IT, cyber, and other hard-to-fill jobs
proposal: The VA should broaden pay and benefits for hard-to-recruit skills such as IT, acquisition, cyber, and economics to compete with private industry.
quote: Broaden pay and benefits in critical VA skill sets (beyond medical care occupations) to be more competitive with private-sector industry.

title: Make full use of new VA hiring and pay authorities
proposal: The VA should keep making full use of hiring and pay authorities in the RAISE Act and PACT Act, plus student loan forgiveness programs.
quote: Continue to maximize the use of new VA hiring and pay authorities provided by Congress

title: Hire more veterans and military spouses at VA
proposal: The VA should focus more on hiring veterans and military spouses.
quote: Focus more attention on hiring veterans and military spouses. The percentage of veterans employed at VA has been declining.

title: Add more political appointee positions at the VA
proposal: The administration should vet candidates early for key VA jobs and work with Congress and OPM to authorize more non-career appointee positions.
quote: Congress and the Office of Personnel Management should be engaged on ways to provide authorities for a higher number of non-career PA positions.

title: Use more limited-term senior executive positions at VA
proposal: The VA should increase limited-term Senior Executive Service positions of up to three years for special projects.
quote: Increase the number and utilization of Limited Term Appointment Senior Executive Service positions for up to three years

title: Eliminate the VA Office of Accountability and Whistleblower Protection
proposal: The administration should work with Congress to close the VA Office of Accountability and Whistleblower Protection, which the chapter calls redundant.
quote: Work with Congress to sunset the Office of Accountability and Whistleblower Protection (OAWP).

title: Separate VA human resources and security offices
proposal: The VA should consider splitting Human Resources and Administration from the Office of Security and Preparedness.
quote: Consider decoupling HRA and the Office of Security and Preparedness (OSP).
